hypothesis: Publisher target/pathway annotations add inductive predictive information for wholly held compound identities beyond known-state/dose response means
source: Corrected CC-BY-4.0 sciPlex release, existing exact four-dose prepared bank; same 24 lexicographic compounds, three known lines, 24h and 512 genes
qualification: Metadata-only constancy/missingness audit, checksum, release license and publisher processing provenance before new candidate scores. Target/pathway fields are inherited from primary pData, not expression-derived annotations.
limits: Annotations are permitted external information, not verified biochemical mechanisms or chemical structures. No scaffold holdout or unseen biological state claim.
allowed_information: Known line and exact dose, source compound single effects, query vehicle controls for fixed panel/subtraction, query intervention annotation; every held compound response at every dose/state excluded from fitting, scaling, selection, pretraining and calibration
preprocessing: Reuse declared per-cell normalization and matched-plate subtraction; equal available plate means within line; source-only categorical vocabulary and feature scaling, explicit unknown/missing masks; no query effects

splits.identity: four identity folds, lexicographically sorted compounds assigned modulo four; inner whole identity folds
splits.target_class: connected components of overlapping comma-separated target annotation tokens; components greedily balanced into four folds using metadata only; inner whole component folds

candidate_menu.shuffled_annotation: same complete 24-model ridge/kernel search, fixed metadata permutation; no enlargement

endpoint: Equal condition gene MSE on common 288 profiles per track; paired differences against source-selected simple/class mean
uncertainty: 2,000 whole-compound conditional bootstrap draws preserving each compound's three line/four dose profiles; shared controls fixed, no biological/refitting/multiplicity guarantee
decision_rule: At least 5% relative MSE improvement and positive diagnostic 95% lower bound; descriptor advantage also assessed against matched shuffled search. Identity and target-class gates separate.
replication_audit: Primary metadata downloads used for condition/culture provenance only. Distinguish independently treated wells from independently initiated cultures; never infer culture replication from barcode aliases.
publication: local only; no external publication, communication or paid compute
